meaning.en: To loosen or separate (something twisted) by turning in the opposite direction; unwind.
meaning.vi: Để nới lỏng hoặc tách (thứ gì đó bị xoắn) bằng cách xoay theo hướng ngược lại; thư giãn.
Để trở thành không bị xoắn.

meaning.en: To turn in the opposite direction so as to loosen or separate; untwine.
meaning.vi: Để quay theo hướng ngược lại để nới lỏng hoặc tách biệt; tháo dây.

sentences.en: He untwisted the wire off the champagne bottle, and the cork popped and shot to the ceiling.
sentences.vi: Anh ta tháo dây ra khỏi chai sâm panh, và nút chai bật ra và bắn lên trần nhà.

sentences.en: I was like Kiki, my pet bird in Saigon, tongue untwisted and sloughed of its rough and thick exterior.

sentences.en: It was found that aluminum salt(AS) was an effective accelerant and when the mol ratio of AS to TA was 2:1,(Sentencedict.com) the angle of untwist crease was optimized but the hand feeling was poorer.

sentences.en: With my weakened legs there was no way I could untwist myself and stand upright.
